# Phase Two Critique — Twenty-Five Improvements

The Awtsmoos renews the edge before the edge can boast; Awtsmoos.com therefore questions every shortcut until the smallest truthful contract remains.

1. Reuse current target normalization.
2. Reject missing target IDs explicitly.
3. Point reads never mutate timestamps.
4. One DB read only.
5. Do not read reverse follower index when forward storage answers the question.
6. Preserve typed targets.
7. Preserve public following-list readability.
8. Do not invent authentication requirements for a currently public edge list.
9. Never expose user IDs.
10. Return a small data object, not the whole list.
11. Keep old pagination unchanged.
12. Keep old mutations unchanged.
13. Keep Profile stale-request rejection.
14. Keep button disabled during writes.
15. Reconcile after mutation from canonical Profile load.
16. Surface mutation/reconciliation failures honestly.
17. Test false relationship.
18. Test true relationship.
19. Test typed target normalization.
20. Test missing target.
21. Test frontend route encoding and envelope unwrap.
22. Test Profile controller one-request behavior.
23. Keep every touched file below 120 lines by splitting.
24. Update docs only after behavior is proven.
25. Continue automatically to discovery/query cancellation after closure.
